title: PDF viewer window.showSaveFilePicker NotAllowedError
body:
### Preflight Checklist

- [x] I have read the [Contributing Guidelines](https://github.com/electron/electron/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) for this project.
- [x] I agree to follow the [Code of Conduct](https://github.com/electron/electron/blob/main/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md) that this project adheres to.
- [x] I have searched the [issue tracker](https://www.github.com/electron/electron/issues) for a bug report that matches the one I want to file, without success.

### Electron Version

43.0.0-alpha.3, 43.4.1, 44.0.0, 45.0.0-alpha.1

### What operating system(s) are you using?

Windows

### Operating System Version

Windows 11 Enterprise 23H2

### What arch are you using?

x64

### Last Known Working Electron version

43.0.0-alpha.2

### Does the issue also appear in Chromium / Google Chrome?

No

### Expected Behavior

Downloading PDFs with changes should work.

### Actual Behavior

When trying to download a modified PDF "with your changes" the following error is thrown:
window.showSaveFilePicker failed: NotAllowedError: Failed to execute 'showSaveFilePicker' on 'Window': Third party iframes are not allowed to show a file picker.

### Testcase Gist URL

_No response_

### Additional Information

This bug was already present in earlier electron versions and was fixed, see [issue](https://github.com/electron/electron/issues/51041) and [pr](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/51042). The bug is reproducible with the gist of the original issue. 
With version 43.0.0-alpha.3 chromium was updated to 150.0.7834.0 [pr](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/51609). In chromium 150.0.7833.0, the logic for IsFilePickerAllowedForCrossOriginSubframe changed, see this [pr](https://github.com/chromium/chromium/commit/3fd5e2cb1ef275dfe83f63d84d604ededba6ccb1).
Additional note: With electron 43.0.0-alpha.2 the save dialog will open, but if the dialog gets closed via cancel or x button, the electron window cannot be closed and the process has to be killed.
